actions.title: confirm project boundary
actions.instruction: Confirm that this is the Academy attempt root. U04 creates two child repositories under .academy/workspaces/; do not initialize CodeArbiter in the Academy root.
actions.rationale: It distinguishes the controller repository from the two child repositories before any tool writes state.
actions.expected_result: You know the Academy root controls the attempt and the two child paths are .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield and .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield. Next safe step: prepare attempt.
actions.recovery: If you have already initialized CodeArbiter in the Academy root, preserve the status and stop; do not delete or rewrite a repository to hide the mistake.
actions.evidence: Preserve the Academy-root path and the two child paths; no child repository exists yet.

actions.title: prepare attempt
actions.instruction: From the clean Academy root, run installed Academy Prepare. Native commands never begin with !.
actions.rationale: Prepare is the only supported way to create the bounded attempt and its two clean child repositories.
actions.expected_result: Prepare switches to academy/U04-initialize-projects/<attempt> and creates clean .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield and .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield child repositories. Next safe step: inspect root.
actions.recovery: If Prepare reports an occupied child target or another setup error, preserve its output and correct that named boundary; do not create, delete, or initialize a child path by hand.
actions.evidence: Preserve Prepare output, the attempt branch, and empty status from both prepared child repositories.

actions.title: inspect root
actions.instruction: Inspect the two prepared child repositories. Do not initialize the Academy root.
actions.rationale: It proves the prepared paths are separate children rather than accidental work in the Academy root.
actions.expected_result: The listing shows separate U04-greenfield and U04-brownfield directories under .academy/workspaces; neither is the Academy root. Next safe step: inspect greenfield.
actions.recovery: If either child is missing, duplicated, or outside .academy/workspaces, stop and preserve the listing plus all three repository statuses; do not initialize a substitute directory by hand.
actions.evidence: Preserve the two-path listing and the empty prepared-child statuses so the later report remains bound to the intended repositories.

actions.title: inspect greenfield
actions.instruction: Use Open Folder or the workspace switcher to visibly root the host at .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield. A terminal cd does not change the host root.
actions.rationale: The visible host root prevents a greenfield command from being sent to the parent or the brownfield child.
actions.expected_result: The host visibly names .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield as its project root; merely changing a terminal directory is not sufficient. Next safe step: run greenfield init.
actions.recovery: If the host still shows the Academy root or U04-brownfield, do not invoke CodeArbiter; reopen U04-greenfield with Open Folder or the workspace switcher first.
actions.evidence: Preserve the host's visible root label or breadcrumb naming U04-greenfield; Check can verify repository bytes later, but cannot prove which folder the host displayed.

actions.title: run greenfield init
actions.instruction: Only while visibly rooted at .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield, run ca-init; a terminal cd does not change the host root.
actions.rationale: Initialization belongs in the greenfield child so its governance state starts from the real plugin entry point.
actions.expected_result: ca-init scaffolds an uncommitted .codearbiter directory inside U04-greenfield only; the Academy root and brownfield remain untouched. Next safe step: run greenfield decompose.
actions.recovery: If ca-init ran against another visible root, stop and preserve its output and every affected git status; do not commit or conceal the misplaced initialization.
actions.evidence: Preserve ca-init output and U04-greenfield git status showing the new .codearbiter paths before decomposition.

actions.title: run greenfield decompose
actions.instruction: Only while visibly rooted at .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield, run ca-decompose; a terminal cd does not change the host root.
actions.rationale: Decomposition creates the greenfield planning artifacts that reconciliation will evaluate.
actions.expected_result: U04-greenfield now contains .codearbiter/plans/01-architecture-breakdown.md, .codearbiter/plans/02-phased-build-plan.md, and .codearbiter/plans/03-task-backlog.md. Next safe step: read greenfield plans.
actions.recovery: If ca-decompose stops for input or any named plan is missing, preserve the transcript and partial files; continue the decompose interview in U04-greenfield instead of inventing a plan or switching repositories.
actions.evidence: Preserve the ca-decompose transcript and all three generated plan files; Check later reads these exact committed paths.

actions.title: read greenfield plans
actions.instruction: Read .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield/.codearbiter/plans/01-architecture-breakdown.md, .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield/.codearbiter/plans/02-phased-build-plan.md, and .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield/.codearbiter/plans/03-task-backlog.md.
actions.rationale: Reading all three plans makes the later reconciliation a deliberate decision rather than an opaque command.
actions.expected_result: All three plan files are readable and distinguish architecture, phased delivery, and task backlog decisions that must be settled before reconciliation. Next safe step: choose greenfield reconciliation.
actions.recovery: If a file cannot be read or contains incomplete generated content, stop and return to ca-decompose in the visibly rooted greenfield host; do not repair generated structure from the Academy root.
actions.evidence: Preserve the three plan contents and a short list of every [CONFIRM-NN] or design choice that needs a learner decision.

actions.title: choose greenfield reconciliation
actions.instruction: Review the three greenfield plan inputs, resolve decisions or stop on [CONFIRM-NN], then use Open Folder or the workspace switcher to visibly return to .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield. A terminal cd does not change the host root.
actions.rationale: Reconciliation must use learner-resolved decisions and stop on unresolved confirmation markers.
actions.expected_result: Each plan decision has an explicit learner answer, no unresolved [CONFIRM-NN] remains, and the host is visibly rooted at U04-greenfield. Next safe step: run greenfield reconcile.
actions.recovery: If any decision is unclear or [CONFIRM-NN] remains, stop before ca-reconcile; preserve the question and answer it explicitly in the greenfield conversation.
actions.evidence: Preserve the learner-attributed decisions and the resolved three plan files; this is judgment evidence that Check cannot infer from command invocation alone.

actions.title: run greenfield reconcile
actions.instruction: Only after the three plans and learner decisions exist, while visibly rooted at .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield, run ca-reconcile; a terminal cd does not change the host root.
actions.rationale: Running reconcile only after its inputs exist keeps the plan-to-decision flow truthful.
actions.expected_result: ca-reconcile records the reviewed greenfield governance with no unresolved [CONFIRM-NN]. Next safe step: record greenfield ADR.
actions.recovery: If reconciliation reports an unresolved variance or confirmation, preserve the transcript and stop; return to the named greenfield decision instead of staging partial governance.
actions.evidence: Preserve ca-reconcile output and the final plan and governance files that will be reviewed in the unstaged diff.

actions.title: record the accepted greenfield ADR
actions.instruction: While visibly rooted at .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield, state the exact learner-selected greenfield decision and explicit learner attribution, then invoke ca-adr. The host assigns the number and writes the proposed ADR; do not ask ca-reconcile to author it.
actions.rationale: ca-adr, not ca-reconcile, owns an accepted Architecture Decision Record and requires explicit learner attribution.

variants.command: /ca:adr Use local storage for U04 greenfield state
$ca-adr Use local storage for U04 greenfield state
/ca-adr Use local storage for U04 greenfield state
/skill:ca-adr Use local storage for U04 greenfield state

actions.expected_result: ca-adr writes the next numbered proposed greenfield ADR under .codearbiter/decisions/ with the learner-attributed decision. Next safe step: accept greenfield ADR.
actions.recovery: If the decision or attribution is not exact, stop before accepting the ADR. Correct the learner decision in the greenfield conversation; do not ask ca-reconcile to create or revise the ADR.
actions.evidence: Preserve the proposed ADR path and learner-attributed decision with the reconciled plan and governance files.

actions.title: explicitly accept the greenfield ADR
actions.instruction: Review the proposed greenfield ADR in the active ca-adr conversation. Only after confirming its decision and attribution, explicitly accept that ADR; the host must not advance its status on its own.
actions.rationale: ADR status transitions are an explicit learner decision, not an automatic result of reconciliation or drafting.
actions.expected_result: The reviewed learner-attributed ADR is accepted under .codearbiter/decisions/. Next safe step: inspect greenfield changes.
actions.recovery: If the ADR title, decision, or attribution is wrong, leave it proposed and correct it with the learner before accepting. Do not silently edit or auto-advance its status.
actions.evidence: The accepted ADR path, status, decision, and explicit learner attribution.

actions.title: inspect greenfield changes
actions.instruction: Inspect greenfield status and unstaged governance diff before staging.
actions.rationale: An unstaged inspection lets the learner see exactly what the greenfield plugin flow produced.
actions.expected_result: Greenfield status and the unstaged diff show only the intended .codearbiter governance and generated .gitignore change; nothing is staged yet. Next safe step: stage greenfield changes.
actions.recovery: If status names unrelated or unexpected paths, preserve the full status and diff and stop; identify their owner before altering, staging, or discarding them.
actions.evidence: Preserve the pre-stage status and full .codearbiter/.gitignore diff as the review record for the greenfield commit boundary.

actions.title: stage greenfield changes
actions.instruction: After review, stage only greenfield generated governance changes.
actions.rationale: Selective staging keeps generated greenfield governance files separate from unrelated parent or child work.
actions.expected_result: Only reviewed U04-greenfield .codearbiter and .gitignore changes are staged, and diff --cached --name-only prints those exact paths. Next safe step: review greenfield commit boundary.
actions.recovery: If an unexpected path is staged, preserve the cached name list, unstage only that path, and return to the unstaged review; do not run ca-commit with a mixed boundary.
actions.evidence: Preserve the cached name list proving the greenfield index contains only generated governance and its .gitignore boundary.

actions.title: review greenfield commit boundary
actions.instruction: Review the full cached diff, then use Open Folder or the workspace switcher to keep the host visibly rooted at .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield.
actions.rationale: Cached-diff review proves the exact greenfield commit boundary before the commit gate runs.
actions.expected_result: diff --cached --check reports no whitespace errors, and the full cached diff is the exact greenfield governance the learner intends to commit. Next safe step: run greenfield commit gate.
actions.recovery: If the cached check reports an error or the diff contains an unapproved change, preserve the output and stop; correct and restage the greenfield file before requesting ca-commit.
actions.evidence: Preserve the clean cached-check output and reviewed cached diff; together they define the exact bytes offered to the greenfield commit gate.

actions.title: run greenfield commit gate
actions.instruction: Only after learner review while visibly rooted at .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield, run ca-commit; a terminal cd does not change the host root.
actions.rationale: The child-local commit gate records the reviewed greenfield governance change in its own history.
actions.expected_result: ca-commit creates a new child commit in U04-greenfield containing the reviewed staged governance and does not commit either the parent or brownfield. Next safe step: confirm greenfield clean.
actions.recovery: If the gate stops or requests remediation, preserve its findings and the staged diff; remediate in U04-greenfield and rerun ca-commit instead of bypassing the gate or using raw git commit.
actions.evidence: Preserve the successful ca-commit transcript and resulting greenfield commit hash; the later binding must use this committed HEAD.

actions.title: confirm greenfield clean
actions.instruction: After greenfield ca-commit succeeds, confirm its status is empty.
actions.rationale: A clean greenfield status is required before its committed facts can bind the parent report.
actions.expected_result: git status --short prints nothing, so the U04-greenfield working tree is clean after its new child commit. Next safe step: inspect brownfield.
actions.recovery: If any greenfield path is printed, preserve the status and stop before opening brownfield; return to the greenfield review or commit gate that left it dirty.
actions.evidence: Preserve the empty status output and the committed HEAD from the preceding gate; the parent report binds that committed HEAD, tree, and context.

actions.title: inspect brownfield
actions.instruction: After greenfield is committed and clean, use Open Folder or the workspace switcher to visibly root the host at .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield. A terminal cd does not change the host root.
actions.rationale: Switching deliberately to brownfield keeps its existing-source workflow distinct from greenfield decomposition.
actions.expected_result: The greenfield remains committed and clean while the host visibly names .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield as its new project root. Next safe step: run brownfield init.
actions.recovery: If greenfield is dirty or the host displays any root other than U04-brownfield, stop; preserve both statuses and switch folders visibly before invoking CodeArbiter.
actions.evidence: Preserve the clean greenfield status and the host's visible U04-brownfield root label so the route transition is auditable.

actions.title: run brownfield init
actions.instruction: Only while visibly rooted at .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield, run ca-init; a terminal cd does not change the host root.
actions.rationale: Brownfield initialization starts governance in the existing child, never in the Academy root.
actions.expected_result: ca-init scaffolds an uncommitted .codearbiter directory inside U04-brownfield only while preserving its existing source files. Next safe step: run brownfield create context.
actions.recovery: If ca-init targets another root or changes existing brownfield source, stop and preserve the transcript and status; do not commit, reset, or mask those changes.
actions.evidence: Preserve ca-init output and brownfield status showing new governance beside, not replacing, the prepared source.

actions.title: run brownfield create context
actions.instruction: Only while visibly rooted at .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield, run ca-create-context; a terminal cd does not change the host root. Keep this route bound to existing source and do not use ca-decompose on the brownfield. ca-create-context does not create the three ca-reconcile plan inputs.
actions.rationale: Create-context is the genuine brownfield route and does not invent greenfield plan artifacts.
actions.expected_result: ca-create-context derives brownfield governance from existing source, including .codearbiter/CONTEXT.md, and creates none of the three greenfield reconciliation plan files. Next safe step: inspect brownfield changes.
actions.recovery: If the host proposes ca-decompose, synthetic reconciliation plans, or context unrelated to the existing source, stop and preserve the transcript; rerun ca-create-context only from the visible brownfield root.
actions.evidence: Preserve the ca-create-context transcript, generated root governance paths, and absence of .codearbiter/plans/01-architecture-breakdown.md, 02-phased-build-plan.md, and 03-task-backlog.md.

actions.title: inspect brownfield changes
actions.instruction: Inspect brownfield status and unstaged governance diff before staging.
actions.rationale: Inspecting the brownfield diff exposes the exact context artifacts before they become committed evidence.
actions.expected_result: Brownfield status and the unstaged diff show only intended .codearbiter context derived from the prepared source; existing source is unchanged and nothing is staged yet. Next safe step: stage brownfield changes.
actions.recovery: If status names source edits, reconciliation plans, or unrelated paths, preserve the full status and diff and stop; do not stage or discard them as generated context.
actions.evidence: Preserve the pre-stage brownfield status and full .codearbiter diff as the review record for the context-creation boundary.

actions.title: stage brownfield changes
actions.instruction: After review, stage only brownfield generated governance changes.
actions.rationale: Selective staging confines the brownfield commit to generated governance state.
actions.expected_result: Only reviewed U04-brownfield .codearbiter changes are staged, and diff --cached --name-only prints those exact governance paths. Next safe step: review brownfield commit boundary.
actions.recovery: If an existing source file or any unexpected path is staged, preserve the cached name list, unstage only that path, and return to the brownfield unstaged review.
actions.evidence: Preserve the cached name list proving the brownfield index contains only context-creation governance.

actions.title: review brownfield commit boundary
actions.instruction: Review the full cached diff, then use Open Folder or the workspace switcher to keep the host visibly rooted at .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield.
actions.rationale: Cached-diff review catches an incorrect brownfield boundary before a durable child commit.
actions.expected_result: diff --cached --check reports no whitespace errors, and the full cached diff is the exact brownfield governance the learner intends to commit. Next safe step: run brownfield commit gate.
actions.recovery: If the cached check reports an error or the diff contains source edits, plans, or another unapproved change, preserve the output and stop; correct the brownfield index before ca-commit.
actions.evidence: Preserve the clean cached-check output and reviewed cached diff; together they define the exact bytes offered to the brownfield commit gate.

actions.title: run brownfield commit gate
actions.instruction: Only after learner review while visibly rooted at .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield, run ca-commit; a terminal cd does not change the host root.
actions.rationale: The brownfield child must pass its own commit gate so its history is independently verifiable.
actions.expected_result: ca-commit creates a new child commit in U04-brownfield containing the reviewed staged context and does not commit either the parent or greenfield. Next safe step: confirm brownfield clean.
actions.recovery: If the gate stops or requests remediation, preserve its findings and the staged diff; remediate in U04-brownfield and rerun ca-commit instead of bypassing it or using raw git commit.
actions.evidence: Preserve the successful ca-commit transcript and resulting brownfield commit hash; the later binding must use this committed HEAD.

actions.title: confirm brownfield clean
actions.instruction: After brownfield ca-commit succeeds, confirm its status is empty.
actions.rationale: A clean brownfield status proves no uncommitted state is hidden behind the parent binding.
actions.expected_result: git status --short prints nothing, so the U04-brownfield working tree is clean after its new child commit. Next safe step: inspect project evidence.
actions.recovery: If any brownfield path is printed, preserve the status and stop before binding; return to the brownfield review or commit gate that left it dirty.
actions.evidence: Preserve the empty status output and the committed HEAD from the preceding gate; the parent report binds that committed HEAD, tree, and context.

actions.title: inspect project evidence
actions.instruction: Only after both child ca-commit gates succeed and both statuses are empty, inspect committed heads, trees, context digests, and statuses.
actions.rationale: The parent report may bind only committed child heads and trees, so inspect those immutable facts first.

variants.command:
git -C .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield status --short
git -C .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield status --short
git -C .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}'
git -C .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}'
shasum -a 256 .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield/.codearbiter/CONTEXT.md .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield/.codearbiter/CONTEXT.md

git -C .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield status --short
git -C .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield status --short
git -C .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}'
git -C .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield rev-parse HEAD 'HEAD^{tree}'
sha256sum .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield/.codearbiter/CONTEXT.md .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield/.codearbiter/CONTEXT.md

actions.expected_result: Both status commands print nothing, followed by each child's committed HEAD, committed tree, and context digest from .codearbiter/CONTEXT.md. Next safe step: write binding report.
actions.recovery: If either status is nonempty or any HEAD, tree, or digest is missing, preserve all output and return to that child; do not generate a parent report from partial or uncommitted state.
actions.evidence: Preserve the six binding values and both empty statuses exactly as printed; they are the source facts the canonical writer must bind.

actions.title: write binding report
actions.instruction: After both children are committed and clean, run the supported canonical writer from the Academy root. Never hand-author verifier-sensitive report bytes.
actions.rationale: The supported writer derives canonical report bytes from live child repositories instead of trusting a hand-written claim.
actions.expected_result: The writer creates .codearbiter/reports/academy/U04-initialization.md with canonical generated bytes bound to both clean committed children. Next safe step: inspect report.
actions.recovery: If the writer reports a dirty, uncommitted, or wrong-layout child, preserve the message and return only to that child; do not hand-author the report.
actions.evidence: Preserve the canonical report at its exact path plus each child's committed HEAD, committed tree, and context digest that it records.

actions.title: inspect report
actions.instruction: Inspect the canonical parent report before staging.
actions.rationale: Inspecting the generated report verifies its binding facts before it enters the parent commit.
actions.expected_result: The report displays Greenfield, Brownfield, and Route evidence sections with the exact child paths, HEADs, trees, CONTEXT-SHA256 digests, and route artifacts. Next safe step: stage report.
actions.recovery: If a field is absent or differs from the inspected child evidence, preserve the report and child outputs, then rerun the canonical writer after fixing the child state; do not edit the report.
actions.evidence: Preserve the displayed canonical report and compare every binding field to the immediately preceding child evidence.

actions.title: stage report
actions.instruction: After review, stage only the canonical parent report.
actions.rationale: Staging only the canonical report prevents child content or unrelated parent files from entering the binding commit.
actions.expected_result: Only .codearbiter/reports/academy/U04-initialization.md is staged in the Academy parent, and diff --cached --name-only prints exactly that path. Next safe step: review commit boundary.
actions.recovery: If any other parent path is staged, preserve the cached list and unstage only the unexpected path; leave both child histories untouched.
actions.evidence: Preserve the one-line cached name list naming only .codearbiter/reports/academy/U04-initialization.md.

actions.title: review commit boundary
actions.instruction: Confirm only the report is staged and both children are clean. Then use Open Folder or the workspace switcher to return to the Academy root.
actions.rationale: The parent cached diff must contain only the report while both child repositories remain clean.
actions.expected_result: The parent index contains only U04-initialization.md, both child statuses remain empty, and the host visibly shows the Academy root. Next safe step: run commit gate.
actions.recovery: If another parent path is staged, either child is dirty, or the host shows a child root, stop; preserve the cached list and statuses and correct only that boundary before ca-commit.
actions.evidence: Preserve the single staged report path, both empty child statuses, and the visible Academy-root label presented to the parent commit gate.

actions.title: run commit gate
actions.instruction: Only at the visibly confirmed Academy root, run ca-commit; do not run it in either child.
actions.rationale: The Academy-root commit gate preserves the separation between parent evidence and child governance history.
actions.expected_result: ca-commit creates a new Academy-parent commit whose only changed path is .codearbiter/reports/academy/U04-initialization.md; child histories do not change. Next safe step: confirm clean.
actions.recovery: If the parent gate stops, preserve its findings and staged report; remediate from the Academy root and rerun ca-commit without recommitting either child.
actions.evidence: Preserve the successful parent ca-commit transcript, new parent commit hash, and its one-path diff naming only the canonical U04 report.

actions.title: confirm clean
actions.instruction: Confirm parent, greenfield, and brownfield status are empty.
actions.rationale: Three clean statuses prove the complete evidence topology is settled before acceptance.

variants.command:
git status --short
git -C .academy\workspaces\U04-greenfield status --short
git -C .academy\workspaces\U04-brownfield status --short

git status --short
git -C .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield status --short
git -C .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield status --short

git status --short
git -C .academy/workspaces/U04-greenfield status --short
git -C .academy/workspaces/U04-brownfield status --short

actions.expected_result: All three status commands print nothing: the Academy parent, U04-greenfield, and U04-brownfield working trees are clean. Next safe step: recognize the accepted result.
actions.recovery: If any command prints a path, preserve all three outputs and return only to the repository that is dirty; do not reset or rewrite either committed child history.
actions.evidence: Preserve the three empty status outputs and current parent and child HEADs as the final clean-state record.

actions.title: check status
actions.instruction: From the clean Academy root, run installed Academy Check after committing the canonical parent report.
actions.rationale: Check validates durable child and parent facts, not an unobservable claim that a host command was invoked.
actions.expected_result: Check prints checkpoint U04-initialize-projects: passed and records progress only after it sees the clean committed parent report and both committed child states. Next safe step: preserve the completed attempt.
actions.recovery: If Check names a child or parent fact that does not match, preserve its output and return only to that boundary; do not infer success from a command exit alone.
actions.evidence: Preserve Check output and the committed child HEADs, trees, context digests, and parent report it validated.

actions.title: reset retry
actions.instruction: If you need to recover, invoke installed Academy Reset only to read its preservation diagnostic. U04 Reset intentionally refuses until Academy can archive both child histories.
actions.rationale: Reset must refuse rather than discard child history until a supported archival path exists.
actions.expected_result: Reset reports that it is unavailable until Academy can archive both child repository histories and leaves all three repositories unchanged. Next safe step: preserve state and correct the named child or parent boundary.
actions.recovery: Use the status, cached-diff, and commit cards for the named repository. Do not delete, reset, or rewrite either committed child history to make status look clean.
actions.evidence: Preserve the Reset diagnostic plus parent and child status before and after it; their equality proves no history was rewritten.
